title: [review] project-LICHEN-6mij.2.4: deaddrop_oscore_respond prototype mismatch vs coap_oscore_protect_response signature for ctx
description: In coap_dtn.c:90-107, deaddrop_oscore_respond() takes 'struct oscore_ctx *ctx' but coap_oscore_auth_result.ctx is declared '_Nonnull struct oscore_ctx *ctx'. However auth.ctx may be NULL on the local-admin path, and callers guard with 'if (auth.ctx != NULL)' before calling deaddrop_oscore_respond. This is handled correctly at the call sites, but the function itself does not null-check ctx before passing it to coap_oscore_protect_response. If a caller ever calls it without the guard, it will dereference NULL. Add a defensive NULL check or leave as-is with a note that callers must guard. Minor but worth flagging.
